name: Patient Visits Summary report
query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN h.unique_visits > 20 THEN '20+'
    ELSE CAST(h.unique_visits AS CHAR)
  END AS visit_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
  SUM(h.total_records) AS total_que_records_in_bucket
FROM (
  SELECT
    q.patient,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(q.`date`)) AS unique_visits,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records
  FROM `tabQue` q
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT patient
    FROM `tabQue`
    WHERE status <> 'Canceled'
      AND `date` BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  ) cohort ON cohort.patient = q.patient
  WHERE q.status <> 'Canceled'
  GROUP BY q.patient
) h
GROUP BY visit_bucket
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN visit_bucket = '20+' THEN 999999
    ELSE CAST(visit_bucket AS UNSIGNED)
  END;
